history.title: The Hollow Sun
history.outcomeText: Recovered Last Light of Sundrift, a frigate.

history.title: The Patient Reef
history.outcomeText: Paid 35 credits and 20 minerals. Preservation begun. Three qualifying colony cycles will open a further decision; the opportunity remains with this world.

history.title: Garden Between Stars
history.outcomeText: Gained 20 science. Habitability increased by 25 points.

factions.name: The Concord
factions.description: A federation of survivors, united by a fragile promise. Receives one additional order each turn.

factions.name: Veyr Consortium
factions.description: Trade leagues that turn the frontier into opportunity. Earns 25% more credits.

factions.name: Khar Dominion
factions.description: A martial society forged on hostile worlds. Warships deal 15% more damage.

factions.name: The Luminous Choir
factions.description: A communion seeking the intelligence behind the ancient gates. Produces 25% more science.

log.text: Khar Dominion achieves transcendence. The chronicle of this age is complete.

First mandate: send your Pathfinder through a starlane, then bring a Colony Ark to a habitable world.
The gates have been silent for centuries. Today, the Concord returns to the stars.
